user.title: Set up Weight Gurus Scale
user.description: Select your discovered Weight Gurus scale or enter its Bluetooth MAC address manually.

manual_mac.title: Enter Scale MAC Address
manual_mac.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your Weight Gurus scale (found on the scale label or from your previous logs).

confirm.title: Configure Weight Gurus Scale ({name})
confirm.description: Configure your scale and user profile settings. Height is used to calculate BMI.

error.invalid_mac: Invalid Bluetooth MAC address format (must be 6 hex byte pairs separated by colons, e.g. 04:7B:CB:DF:95:CF).

abort.already_configured: This scale is already configured in Home Assistant.
abort.not_supported: The discovered device is not a supported Weight Gurus scale.

init.title: Configure User Profile
init.description: Update user profile settings for this scale. Height is used to calculate BMI.
